long_biography.plain_text:
Rompharm combined drug manufacturing with the promotion of medicines in Russia, where Tencho Shikov led its representative business. Its factories supplied European pharmaceutical partners as well as the company’s own markets. The production sites held European manufacturing certification and subsequently gained Russian certification.

In 2016, Rompharm bought the rights to the Swiss production technology and trademark for Rumalon, an injectable medicine. The company brought the product into its own manufacturing network and began Russian deliveries that December. Shikov placed particular emphasis on keeping experienced department heads, marketers and sales staff together.

confidence.reason: Shikov's detailed contemporary business interview directly supports these historical operating claims. It is labelled paid content, so claims are confined to described business actions, without efficacy, superiority or patient-outcome assertions.
